articleTypes.name: Non-standard Article
articleTypes.description: Formats outside the standard types: summaries from professional society meetings, manuscripts adapted from Congressional testimony, health policy briefs written for legislators, comments submitted to federal agencies, interviews with health care experts, and point/counterpoint manuscripts. A pre-submission inquiry — title, author list, a brief description or abstract, article type and word count, and why the journal should consider it — is suggested but not required.

journalNotes: Open access (CC BY or CC BY-NC); single-anonymised peer review, typically 2 reviewers; ICMJE authorship; ORCID encouraged; a signed ICMJE disclosure form for every author by the latest revision; data and code sharing strongly encouraged where ethically feasible.
unread: academic.oup.com blocks automated download of this page (HTTP 403), and the page fetcher's text of it holds the policy sections but not the article-type sections. The article-type limits come from search-indexed excerpts of the official page, cross-checked across several queries. The Preparing Your Manuscript section (cover letter, title page, abstract guidance and checklist, teaser text, alternative names, acknowledgments and funding, style, abbreviations, tables, figures and alt text, references, supplementary material) was supplied by hand from the page on 2026-10-15 and is encoded in the network's config in build_corpus.py. Not stated anywhere read: which sections a Brief Report, Review Article, Policy Inquiry or Commentary must carry; line spacing, font and line numbers.
